# Systemize

> Systemize designs and builds websites, custom platforms, AI-supported workflows, dashboards, and digital products as one connected system for founders and small businesses. Led by founder Liz Beaty.

Systemize turns a business idea or bottleneck into a working digital system, rather than a one-off website or a single automation. The deliverable is an architecture where the site, portal, dashboards, and automations are designed to work together.

## Services

- Websites and digital experiences
- Custom business platforms and customer onboarding
- AI business systems: lead qualification, internal AI assistants, CRM automation
- Executive dashboards and reporting automation
- Custom web and mobile applications
- Marketing and growth systems

## Engagement models

- Strategy & System Mapping: for businesses that need clarity and a scalable architecture before committing to a build.
- Focused Build: a single custom-built system (website, dashboard, workflow, or tool) solving one clear bottleneck.
- Platform Partnership: staged architecture, development, and testing for larger ideas built for long-term growth.

Projects typically start at $8,000, with most engagements ranging $20,000–$80,000, scoped to goals, complexity, integrations, and launch requirements.
